先放松，再顺带养头皮——这里是 Midtown 的一家 head spa，韩式头皮疗法配中式养生手法，做的是正经的 scalp treatment 头皮护理：在水泥森林里躲进这一片绿，听着环形淋水的声音，闻着草本和生姜的天然香气，做一小时放松头疗，把压力和没睡好的疲惫一起放下来。每天早上 10 点到晚上 8 点，下班后在打烊前来这片绿歇一小时再回家。一个人来，这里独属于你；两个人来，也欢迎——我们有双人房，等你和最亲近的人一起躲进来。Unwind first — caring for your scalp comes along with it. This is a head spa in Midtown Manhattan: Korean-inspired scalp therapy with Chinese wellness rituals — a proper scalp treatment, tucked into the concrete jungle. The sound of the halo rinse, the natural scent of herbs and ginger, an hour of relaxation head spa to let stress and tiredness go. Open daily 10am to 8pm, so you can rest in this green for an hour after work before heading home. Come alone and it is all yours; come as two and you are just as welcome — we have double rooms waiting for you and the person closest to you.

Why the Scalp · 为什么先看头皮为什么先看头皮

先放松下来，头皮顺带看一看。Unwind first — we will look at your scalp along the way.

在 Midtown 搜 head spa、scalp treatment 的人，多半不是想治什么，就是想找个地方把头和脑子一起放空——这正是这里做的事。来这里，第一件事不是治什么，是放松：躺下来，听着水声，闻着草本的天然香气，让紧绷的头皮和脑子先松开。放松做着做着，我们顺带帮你看一眼头皮状态——有点头屑出油、或者掉发多了，就顺手用草本、生姜这些天然材料养一养。头皮是头发的土壤，不用当成看病，土壤顺带养好了，这片绿自然长得好。Most people searching for a head spa or a scalp treatment in Midtown are not looking for a cure — they want a place to empty out a busy head. That is exactly what happens here. The first thing is not fixing anything — it is unwinding: lie down, listen to the water, breathe in the natural herbal scent, and let a tight scalp and a busy mind loosen. While you relax, we take a look at your scalp along the way — a few flakes, some oil, a bit more shedding — and care for it gently with natural herbs and ginger. The scalp is the soil your hair grows from; tend it along the way, and this green takes care of itself.

Your First Visit · 第一次来第一次来

三步，不用猜Three steps, no guesswork

1

预约时先说说你的问题 Book and tell us your concern

睡不好、头屑出油、头发干枯毛躁、掉发变多——不管你是哪种情况，预约时告诉我们，我们帮你对上合适的项目。Poor sleep, flakes and oil, dry frizzy hair, more shedding — whatever brought you here, tell us when you book and we will match the treatment.

2

先看头皮，再定项目 We read your scalp first

到店先看头皮的实际状态，再定做哪一项、用什么护理。不盲目推贵的，适合的才推荐。Every visit starts with a look at the scalp. The care we choose depends on what we find there — no hard sell.

3

走的时候带一份护理建议 Leave with a plan

做一次是舒服，按月回来，慢慢就成了习惯：还是那位记得你的技师、你习惯的那个角落。多久来一次适合你，我们实话告诉你，并拍照和上次对比。One visit feels good; come back monthly and it becomes a rhythm — the same therapist who remembers you, your usual corner. We tell you honestly how often suits you, and compare photos each time.

FAQ · 常见问题常见问题

问题解答Questions, answered

所有发质都能做吗？Does it work for all hair types?

能。所有发质都能做，护理前会先看头皮和发质状态再定方案。Yes, all hair types — we check your scalp and hair first, then choose the care.

孕妇和小孩能做吗？Is it safe during pregnancy, and for kids?

能。用的是温和植物产品，孕妇和小孩也能做，预约时说明情况即可。Yes — gentle plant-based products, safe during pregnancy and for kids. Just tell us when you book.

能几个人一起做吗？Can we come as a couple or a group?

可以。有双人房，最多能同时接 7 个人，朋友聚会、情侣一起做都行，组团建议提前预约留房。Yes — double rooms for couples, and groups of up to 7 at once. Book ahead for groups so we can hold the rooms.

染烫后几天能做？How soon after color or a perm can I come?

染烫后可以做头疗帮头皮和发质恢复，建议和染烫隔开几天再来；预约时先说明刚做过什么，我们看头皮状态再定当次做什么。A head spa helps scalp and hair recover after color or a perm — give it a few days in between, and tell us what you had done when you book.

第一次来选哪个项目？What should I book first?

先选组：想放松走放松组——只想放松，选减压头疗 30 分钟 $68 先试。头皮有小问题接着看改善组，顺带养一养：草本去屑头皮护理 $128、深层滋养修护护发 $128、生姜养发生发 $118。想一次做全套、或者两个人一起来，再往后看双人同行与组合：组合 $170 起，两个人来就选双人同行，进双人房。Pick a group first: Relaxation for unwinding — the 30-minute Stress Relief at $68 to start. Then, if your scalp or hair needs it, the Care group rides along: Herbal Anti-Dandruff Scalp Care $128, Deep Nourish Hair Repair $128, Ginger Hair Growth Care $118. After that, For Two & Combos: a full combo from $170, or a double room for two.

店在哪里？怎么联系？营业到几点？Where are you, and what are your hours?

224 W 35th St Ste 204, New York, NY 10001，在 Penn Station 和 Herald Square 之间。电话 718-869-9452。每天 10:00–20:00，下班后在打烊前过来做个 30 分钟减压头疗再回家也来得及。可以电话预约，也可以直接到店，有空位就能做；周末建议先预约。224 W 35th St Ste 204, New York, NY 10001 — between Penn Station and Herald Square. Call 718-869-9452. Open daily 10am–8pm — time for a 30-minute Stress Relief after work before you head home. Walk-ins welcome when a room is open; weekends fill up, so booking ahead helps.
